sous_titre: Milliards de dollars par trimestre, du deuxième trimestre 2025 au deuxième trimestre 2026

T2 2025.texte: Global semiconductor sales were $179.7 billion during the second quarter of 2025, an increase of 7.8% compared to Q1.

T3 2025.texte: Global semiconductor sales were $208.4 billion during the third quarter of 2025, an increase of 15.8% compared to Q2.

T4 2025.texte: Fourth-quarter sales of $236.6 billion were 37.1% more than the fourth quarter of 2024.

T1 2026.texte: Global semiconductor sales were $298.5 billion during the first quarter of 2026, an increase of 25% compared to Q4 of 2025.

T2 2026.texte: Global semiconductor sales were $403.3 billion during the second quarter of 2026.
